list: The official 55 trophies, names/descriptions/grades from the PS5 list; rarity = Exophase % on 20 Nov 2026; guides in our own words, sources cited per trophy.

trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and the platinum pops on its own. Plan around the one missable first, then grind the 100% checklist last — nothing else here is missable.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing — the first mission of the game, unmissable. Just play through Lucia and Jason's first job together.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 1. Keep playing the story; the trophy pops at the chapter's final cutscene. While you are in Chapter 1, do the Lucia balcony meditation for Positive Mental Attitude — it is the game's only missable.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2. Story only — the trophy pops when the chapter ends, so there is nothing to prepare for.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3. Story only — it pops at the chapter's end. Use the chapter to start the side strands and the collectibles that open up in Vice City.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4. Story only — the penultimate chapter's end pops it. Before the finale, finish any stranger strands you still owe.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Complete the final mission and finish the story — the gold pops with the ending. After the credits, free roam stays open for the clean-up grind.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. An early, unmissable mission — it pops when the run ends.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. Unmissable as you play the story — the heist itself is the trophy.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. Unmissable — it pops when the mission ends.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. Unmissable story mission — keep playing and it pops.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown at the airport. Unmissable — the takedown itself earns it.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. Unmissable — it pops when the operation ends.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Attain 100% completion. The checklist is lenient — about 60% true completion: 200 of 277 vehicles, 100 of 255 animals, 70 of 80 challenges. Use the in-game stats page as your checklist and mop up the cheapest categories first; the grind trophies below feed straight into it.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. Airtime, near-misses and drifts all count — chain stunt jumps around Vice City in a fast car and the counter climbs quickly. A long highway run with jumps beats grinding one spot.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once: fishing, bowling, shooting range, drone racing, arcade, races and the rest. One try each is enough — no wins needed, just sample them all.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Use the range's practice mode to learn each lane first, then gold them one by one — the pistol lanes are the easiest warm-up before the rifle and moving-target lanes.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every one of the 14 locations. Learn each track's shortcut gates; the races are short, so retrying a lost one costs almost nothing.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Street, off-road and boat races all count — pick the shortest circuits and a tuned car, and a win in each event type banks a different race.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fish the marked spots to level your rod, keep the line tension in the green, then take Cal's challenge once your gear is upgraded.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Any arcade cabinet works — pick the shortest game on it and finish a full run; you do not need a high score.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Finish Andy's stranger strand — his missions unlock across the map as the story advances, so check the '?' markers after each chapter.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Finish Kenton's stranger strand; his missions appear as the story opens new areas of Leonida.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Finish Billy's stranger strand — keep returning to his '?' marker between story missions until his finale unlocks.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. There are more than 8 strands, so skip any that stall you — follow the '?' markers on the map after each chapter and finish any eight.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Finish Randy's stranger strand; his finale unlocks once his earlier missions are done.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Finish Tyrone's stranger strand — his missions unlock as the story advances, so sweep the map for his marker between chapters.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every one of the 18 spots across Leonida. MISSABLE: do the Chapter 1 balcony meditation with Lucia right after 'Down to Earth' — if you leave that balcony without meditating, the spot is gone for this playthrough. The other 17 spots stay open all game, so sweep them in free roam after the story.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret marks the animal's territory on your map — track it, take the shot from cover, and bring the pelt back to him.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards hide in shops, gloveboxes and mission rewards — trade duplicates at the card shop to finish sets faster instead of hunting every single card.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. The WAiNK app pings when you are near a spot — open it, snap the view, and move on. Cluster the downtown spots into one drive to clear them fast.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges span combat, driving and exploration — the in-game checklist shows which are closest, so clear the low-hanging ones first and let the rest come naturally.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner and escape the heat. Build a 4-star wanted level with your partner in the car, then break line of sight in the swamps or a tunnel until the stars clear.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level. Plan a route past three shops, keep the getaway car close, and do not let the wanted level drop between robberies — speed matters more than loot.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Every new vehicle you sit in counts — sweep parking lots and dealerships; the counter ticks fast early on and slows near the end, so save the rare spawns for last.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Trigger Combat Focus in a crowded fight — a gang shootout or a 4-star escape — and line up five targets before it ends.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. Steal a plane from the airport and take off without following the tower — expect a wanted level on the runway, so climb fast and leave the airspace.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Deal with the Rhino tanks. Lure a tank into a narrow street, hit it with sticky bombs from cover, or climb aboard when the hatch opens and take it for yourself.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet at night, stick to the blind spots, and leave before the alarm trips — a slow, silenced approach beats a fast one here.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Vaults need planning — case each bank, bring a fast getaway car, and lose the heat before the next one. Five separate vaults, so spread them across the map.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Block the truck, crack it open, grab the cash and break line of sight fast — the trucks run set routes, so wait for one on a quiet stretch.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. Drive every road — the map shades each area in as you enter it. The last few are the small islands and the northern swamps, so check the map for unshaded corners.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Each gang's operation shows on the map once you have met them — hit one per gang and get clear before their backup arrives.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Walk to the Ocean Beach bar, order the cocktail, and watch the view — it pops as you sip. Best done at sunset.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive a car through the showroom's glass front — the trophy pops as you burst out onto the street.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Play a full game at that alley — the trophy is about the follow-through, so finish the game rather than quitting early. Single source: GTAScoop is the only guide to have pinned the trigger so far.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. Single source: GTAScoop is the only guide to have pinned the trigger so far — it is reported as a partnership moment tied to social-media attention. Play the partner missions and keep an eye on the in-game social feed; treat this one as unconfirmed until a second guide matches it.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Choices made, for better or worse. PSN tracks a count toward 500 — keep making story and side choices as you play and it ticks up on its own; it cannot be farmed in one sitting, so let it build across the run.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. UNCONFIRMED — no guide has pinned the trigger yet; the description hints at succeeding on a second attempt at something. Marked honestly: do not chase it until the community confirms the method.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? UNCONFIRMED — no guide has pinned the trigger yet; it reads like a rare random encounter somewhere in Leonida. Marked honestly until the community confirms it — keep playing and it may surprise you.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. Drive past a pedestrian and swing a melee weapon from the car — it pops on the knockdown. A slow cruise through a busy sidewalk makes it easy.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from heists and robberies — launder them through your contacts a little at a time; the counter tracks the running total.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Buy clothes, food, ammo and car mods — normal spending across a playthrough gets most of the way there; top it up with car mods at the end.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties. Garages go on sale around the map — buy all eight; they also store your best cars, so pick the spots you will actually use.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Scan 10 different vehicles into the Scooter Bros app — any ten you find on the street count, so do it while you are out discovering vehicles anyway.
trophies.name: On the Spot
